_comment: C-first hatch timer probe frozen before recording. C source rejects the earlier jackal egg because jackals lack M1_OVIPAROUS; this independent correction wishes an egg of giant ant, whose monster definition has M1_OVIPAROUS, so objnam.c:can_be_hatched can assign corpsenm and set_corpsenm can attach HATCH_EGG. The bounded wait observes the source-selected timer and timeout.c:hatch_egg if the timer is reached. Preserve a timer/setup miss as a target miss.
